title: Shared definitions
description: Definitions used by every Mixtura schema; units of measure are fixed here once.

id.description: Stable identifier: lower-case slug for seed data, 'u-' plus a UUID for user data.

role.description: Role of an ingredient in a drink.

abvPercent.description: Alcohol by volume in percent, 0 to 100 (40 means 40 %, not 0.4).

acidPercent.description: Acid in percent, 0 to 100; the reference acid is fixed in docs/balance.md.

amount.description: A positive quantity in the unit next to it.

timestamp.description: Instant supplied by the host, ISO 8601 in UTC, for example 2026-11-17T09:30:00Z.

unitId.description: Unit id of the unit table (data/units.json): lower-case words joined by hyphen or underscore, for example ml or oz_us.

quantity.description: An amount with its unit id.

range.description: An inclusive range; the engine checks min <= max.

source.description: Where a figure or a record comes from.
